plugin_crm.title: Customer Master
plugin_crm.description: Free Customer master data and lead/opportunity ledger; members from hotel, mall and other systems can resolve to the same customer, without sales automation

duplicates.title: Suspected duplicate customers
duplicates.hint: Several customers share the same phone / ID number / credit code. Save-time dedupe cannot catch historical rows — confirm they are the same one and merge them via "Merge" in the toolbar.
duplicates.empty: No suspected duplicates: every identity key resolves to a single customer.
duplicates.mergeHint: Confirm, then merge via the toolbar

batch.title: Batch actions
batch.updated: Updated {{updated}} customers (ones outside your scope were skipped)

todos.title: My follow-ups
todos.hint: Due, unfinished follow-ups sorted by due date — deal with the oldest first.
todos.empty: Nothing due. Set a "next follow-up date" on a follow-up and it will appear here when due.

tags.title: Tags of "{{name}}"
tags.inputPlaceholder: Type a tag, press Enter (max 10, 20 chars each)

pool.releaseConfirm: Release "{{name}}" to the public pool? Anyone with pool permission can then claim it.
pool.exportDisabled: Export is not available in the pool view; switch back to the customer list

plugin_crm.searchPlaceholder: Name / code / ID no / credit code / external no
plugin_crm.externalNoRequired: Enter the customer number from the external system
plugin_crm.idPairRequired: ID document type and number must be filled in together

fields.name: Name
fields.platformOnly: Custom field definitions are platform-level; only platform admins can change them
fields.title: Title

customer.deleteBatchConfirm: Delete the {{count}} selected customer(s)? Their contacts and follow-up records go with them and cannot be recovered. Customers that still have opportunities are left alone.
customer.deletedPartial: Deleted {{deleted}} of {{total}} customer(s) (the rest still have opportunities or are outside your data scope)

namePlaceholder.company: Exactly as on the business license

customer.typeHintPerson: Individuals are identified by document: nationality plus ID type and number line up with hotel check-in and cross-border order records.
customer.nationalityHint: Legal nationality (which country the person holds), paired with ID type/number for real-name checks
customer.countryHint: Where the customer is based, for both persons and companies; ISO codes shown in the UI language
customer.typeHintCompany: Companies are identified by the unified social credit code; the people you deal with go in Contacts below, one per person, and the opportunity's default contact is picked from there.
customer.codeHint: Leave the code empty to auto-generate one (C- prefix); it is only used for list display and search. You can also enter your own code. Level is for display only.
customer.anchorHint: Pick the external system and enter its customer number so the member resolves to the same customer; it cannot be changed after creation.

field.title: Custom fields
field.hint: Attach extra business info to every customer (e.g. member source, intent level). Values save with the customer; deleting a definition keeps stored history values.
field.label: Field label
field.codeHint: Lowercase-starting letters/digits/underscore, max 32; used in export headers and search
field.optionsHint: Comma-separated; a select value must exactly match one option
field.deleteConfirm: Delete custom field "{{label}}"? Stored values just stop showing; they are not wiped.

merge.migrateSummary: Will move from the source customer: {{contacts}} contacts, {{opportunities}} opportunities, {{activities}} activities.
merge.fillTitle: Empty target fields that will be filled from the source
merge.noFill: No complementary empty fields between the two records.
merge.tagsTitle: Tags brought in from the source

customer.bindHint: After linking, that external member resolves to this same customer; the link cannot be changed once created.
customer.mergeHint: Fold duplicate records into one master customer: contacts, activities and opportunities move over, and blank master fields are filled from the merged one.
customer.mergeTargetHint: The record that stays: its data wins and existing fields are never overwritten.
customer.mergeSourceHint: This record is deleted after merging and cannot be recovered.
customer.mergePick: Search and pick a customer first
customer.mergeConfirm: Merge now? The merged customer is deleted; its contacts, activities and opportunities all move to the master customer.

opp.deleteBatchConfirm: Delete the {{count}} selected lead/opportunity record(s)? This cannot be undone.
opp.deletedPartial: Deleted {{deleted}} of {{total}} record(s) (the rest may already be gone or are outside your data scope)

contact.title: Contacts
contact.hintPerson: The individual customer is usually a contact too; add family or emergency contacts separately.
contact.hintCompany: Add the people at this company (purchasing, admin, IT…); the opportunity's default contact comes from here.

activity.title: Follow-ups
activity.contentPlaceholder: Write down the key points of this conversation…
activity.empty: No follow-ups yet. Click "Log follow-up" to record the first conversation.
